COMBAT LIBERALISM
COMBAT
September 7, 1937
We stand for active ideological struggle because it is the weapon for ensuring unity
within the Party and the revolutionary organizations in the interest of our fight. Every
Communist and revolutionary should take up this weapon
But liberalism rejects ideological struggle and stands for unprincipled peace, thus giving
LIBERALISM
rise to a decadent, Philistine attitude and bringing about political degeneration in certain
nits and individuals in the Party and the revolutionary organizations
Liberalism manifests itself in various wavs.
To let things slide for the sake of peace and friendship when a person has clearly gone
tong, and refrain from principled argument because he is an old acquaintance, a fellow
ownsman. a schoolmate. a close triend. a loved one an old colleague or old subordinate.
Or to touch on the matter lightly instead of going into it thoroughly, so as to keep on good
ns. The result is that both the organization and the individual are harmed. This is one
type of liberalism.

THE PATHOLOGY PIPELINE: FROM SELFISHNESS TO SYSTEMIC DECAY
PHASE 1: PETTY-BOURGEOIS SELFISHNESS
Placing personal interests first and the interests
of the revolution second.
PHASE 2: HYPOCRITICAL APPLICATION
Treating Marxism as abstract dogma. "They talk
Marxism but practice liberalism; they apply Marxism
to others but liberalism to themselves."
PHASE 3: SYSTEMIC CORROSION
"A corrosive which eats away unity."
Undermines cohesion, causes apathy, prevents policy execution, and
alienates the Party from the masses.
